correctness.rationale: The RESULT.md proof reduces the number-conserving eight-dimensional Hamiltonian to two symmetric bright blocks and antisymmetric dark sectors; with s=(b+c)/sqrt(2) its output-phase coefficient Z=conj(xi)*chi*(conj(s)a+conj(d)s), and the phase swing is 4sqrt(e(1-e))|Z|. For any pure two-qubit state of concurrence c, the two marginal Bloch-vector lengths both equal sqrt(1-c^2), giving |conj(s)a+conj(d)s| <= sqrt(1-c^2)/sqrt(2). Identical local y-rotations of a Schmidt state attain every swing from zero to the bound. The traceless two-qubit Hermitian T construction has a product basis with every diagonal zero: diagonalize the first reduced block in a transverse basis, then choose the common perpendicular to the two conditional Bloch vectors. This proves local branch-energy equalization without a global entangled measurement. Maximal concurrence forces vanishing local Bloch vectors and |a|=|d|, hence E_{n+1}-1/2=(1-LQ)(E_n-1/2) for Q in [0,2], including the singlet and L=1 endpoint exceptions. Independently synthesized full Hamiltonians agree in 48 random cases at 1.5e-15 absolute population error. Finite trials do not prove the all-state quantifier; the Bloch and measurement arguments do.
